description: This Python source file defines a Flask Blueprint that provides a minimal REST API endpoint for chat functionality. It handles POST requests to /api/chat, validating input, checking environment variables, and invoking a GeminiService to generate responses. The code includes error handling for configuration, provider errors, and unexpected issues.
